scope_label: confidence in future fulfillment of quality requirements
definition: Quality assurance is the part of quality management concerned with providing a sound basis for expecting quality requirements to be fulfilled.
explanation: Planning, assigned responsibilities, checks, and evidence can support that expectation. Earlier results and present checks matter when they bear on future fulfillment; no assurance activity guarantees every result.
A check may serve both assurance and control. Assurance emphasizes warranted confidence in what will happen; quality control emphasizes work that fulfills the requirements.
